slides.title: Which of your systems **went quiet**?
slides.sub: Quiet and fine look exactly the same from the dashboard.
slides.scene: Corey the sprout sits in a cosy armchair reading a newspaper with a contented smile in a peaceful living room, while through the window behind him the garden sprinkler, the bird feeder and the washing line have all quietly stopped, dusty and overgrown. Gentle, funny.

items.title: The cron job
items.text: Still scheduled. Points at a path you renamed.

items.title: The uptime monitor
items.text: Still green. Watching a hostname that's gone.

items.title: The test file
items.text: Still there. Excluded by a glob someone tightened.

slides.label: How you find out
slides.caption: Usually the day you **actually need it**.
slides.scene: Corey the sprout frantically pulls the cord on a fire alarm in a smoky kitchen, and instead of a bell, a single sad moth flutters out of the alarm box. A small toast fire smoulders in the toaster. Slapstick, funny.

slides.caption: Results reads as **"no failures"**. It also reads as "nothing ran".

slides.text: What's the system you'd be most surprised to find has gone quiet?
